column1: # For the first measurement window the Pre-Registered Prediction and Calibration
# Act applies only to a named pilot subset: bills sponsored by the Innovation
# Centre and the Clerk, and the consequential executive operational orders the
# Clerk lists. government/predict-gate.sh enforces the §2 pre-registration gate
# only for ids named below; an id not listed is out of pilot scope and passes
# ("not_exercised"). If this file is absent the gate fails closed and enforces
# every id, so an unlisted bill cannot silently bypass the Act.
# One id per line (bill id or consequential-order id). Comments (#) and blank
# lines are ignored. The Clerk populates this list.
